errors.evidence: The figure and legend show four categories/slices, not five.
The pie chart actually contains four sectors, so this statement is correct; however the accompanying claim of five categories makes the structure inconsistent and misleading.

errors.text_span: Всички сектори са визуално изразени с дебели линии и имат изразени етикети с процентите си вътре в тях.
errors.evidence: The sectors are 3D/extruded and separated, but the percentage labels are outside the slices with leader lines, not inside the sectors.

errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени по часовниковата стрелка, започвайки от най-големия (червен) и продължавайки в по-малък размер, като най-малкият (лилав) сектор е вдясно от най-големия.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged simply in descending order clockwise from the red slice; the blue slice is at upper right, green at left, and purple at upper left. The description misstates the visual arrangement.
The description does not mention that the pie chart is 3D/extruded and that each slice is slightly separated from the center (exploded effect), both clearly visible in the figure.
